decisions.target: Passengers booked on Kestrel flights to or from Orlando or Philadelphia between December 21 and December 27

actions.action: Backup ground handling contract at both bases for the strike days

decisions.message: Kestrel Air update: workers at our ground handling contractor in Orlando and Philadelphia plan a 48-hour strike on Dec 22-23, so some flights may be late or canceled. We have hired a backup ground handling team for both airports. If your flight is canceled, we will rebook you on the next Kestrel flight with a free seat or refund you in full.
decisions.why:
The backup crews attack the cause: fewer canceled and late flights on the strike days.
It also insures against an extension, which would count against goal 1.
It costs $0.5M and leaves $2.5M for surprises.
